'''Tall Bear''' is a [[wolf]] and part of [[Leafhunter]]'s pack.

==Activities==
[[Perrin Aybara]] contacts Leafhunter's pack, including Tall Bear, after a dream. Perrin is trying to identify a scent. When the wolves recognize the scent, that of [[Darkhound]]s, they all break contact except for Leafhunter.{{ref/book|10|5}}
